_comment: Precommit-autofix routing table. Edit this file to change which model/agent handles each pre-commit hook failure. See templates/skills/precommit-autofix/SKILL.md for full schema documentation.

commit_review.description: Pre-commit Sonnet review pass over staged diff. Checks for blocking issues: bugs, missing tests, convention drift. Skip nits.

rules.description: Cyclomatic complexity violation. Refactor the flagged function to reduce branching.
Missing or malformed Google-style docstring. Add or correct docstrings for the flagged functions/modules.
Exception handling violation (bare except, swallowed exception, or unwrapped I/O). Fix per error-handling policy.
File exceeds line-count limit. Split into sub-modules following the build_phases/build_helpers precedent.
AC YAML file does not conform to schema. Correct required fields and types.
AC file violates per-file AC count limits. Split or archive excess ACs.
Contract-shrinking detected: a return shape, function signature, or dict structure was narrowed without explicit authorization. Restore or get allow_contract_shrinkage approval.
Documentation frontmatter field missing or malformed. Add or correct required frontmatter fields.
Documentation file exceeds maximum length. Trim or split the document.
Dead link detected in documentation. Fix or remove the broken link.
Novel jargon term detected. Triage via glossary-triage agent.
Ticket frontmatter agents: map does not match ## Sign-offs section. Bring all three parity locations into sync.
Potential secret or credential detected in staged files. Remove or redact.
Agent comment is missing feedback-id: line. Add the feedback-id per signoff SKILL.md §2a.
Agent registry inconsistency detected. Ensure agent_registry.json and template files are bidirectionally consistent.
Build output has drifted from template source. Re-run build.py to resync.
Placeholder default value detected in deployed output. Replace with real configuration.
roadmap.json schema violation. Correct required fields and structure.
SQL complexity score exceeds threshold. Refactor the flagged SQL procedure/function.
SQL dependency violation. Resolve the flagged dependency issue.
pytest style violation (e.g. bare assert without message). Fix per pytest style conventions.
Commit touches files outside declared scope. Unstage out-of-scope files or update ticket files_touched.
